g.text: Weekly ARE consultation incidence, all ages, Germany (ARE-Praxis-Sentinel); one row per ISO year, one cell per ISO week
Acute respiratory illness in Germany: does every year follow the same cycle?
Most years share one cycle, a late-winter peak (weeks 5–12 in 9 of 13 complete years) and a summer low, but not all: 2021 had no winter wave, and 2014, 2021, 2022, 2023 peaked in weeks 46–50 instead.
Data: Robert Koch-Institut, ARE-Konsultationsinzidenz (CC BY 4.0). Blank cells: no data reported.
